Ākhu.--The exact sense of this word is uncertain. Zimmer renders it ‘mole,’ while Roth prefers ‘mouse’ or ‘rat.’ It is frequently mentioned in the later Saṃhitās, and is known to the Rigveda, where, however, the word is regarded by Pischel as having acquired the secondary sense of ‘thief.’ This is denied by Hillebrandt.
